title: You Are God

canonical_node.axiom: If God creates genuinely free creatures for love, then certain structures follow from that choice; the limits are inside the created order and inside the analogy, not inside God.
definitions: Free will: the capacity to genuinely choose to appreciate or refuse, not programmed appreciation.
Grace: the spiritual reading of gravity; the gentlest thing that shapes everything, cannot be blocked, always draws closer, never forces.
Love: the spiritual reading of the strong force; strongest thing, holds tighter when pulled apart, gives freedom up close.
Truth: the spiritual reading of electromagnetism; self-sustaining, never degrades, impossible to refuse once seen.
Significance: the spiritual reading of mass-energy; nothing is inert, hidden magnitude beyond appearance.
Necessity: the spiritual reading of thermodynamics; a closed system cannot decrease its own disorder, help must come from outside.
The Word: the spiritual reading of information; minimal-description source code from which everything else is derived.
Constancy: the spiritual reading of relativity; same reality regardless of observer.
Faith: the spiritual reading of quantum; commitment to look collapses possibility into one real outcome.
The bond: the spiritual reading of the weak force; stable inside relationship, decaying outside it, way back always available.
Christ: the spiritual reading of coherence; the one point with no internal duality left to resolve.
derivation: Refusal closes the receiver against the source.
Restoration must come from outside without destroying freedom.
Incarnation enters the system without coercing it.
Cross and resurrection restore from within while preserving identity.
canonical_node.action: Check the physics: verify each of the ten measured properties against real physics; then decide whether the spiritual pattern holds. If any named kill condition occurs, abandon the claim.
boundary: Does not claim God was forced to create, hide, or use a cross.
Does not claim the fall was a mistake or grace was plan B.
Does not push further into divine mechanics beyond the stated analogy.
Does not require science to fail anywhere; it requires science to keep succeeding and the pattern to hold.
test: Verify each of the ten physical laws' measured properties as listed (e.g., gravity 10^36 times weaker than electromagnetism, strong force 137x stronger, etc.).
Check if Euclid (October 2026) shows w(z) = -1 exactly; if so, the cosmological claim dies.
Check if SPARC shows no G_eff modification needed; if so, the rotation curve prediction dies.
Check if a closed-system model makes identical predictions; if so, the open-system claim dies.

dg1_dependencies: Measured properties of gravity, strong force, electromagnetism, mass-energy, thermodynamics, information, relativity, quantum mechanics, weak force, and coherence.
General relativity and quantum mechanics as currently understood.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structured mapping between ten physical laws and ten spiritual concepts, with explicit kill conditions, enabling a testable framework for evaluating the analogy.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the integrity of the physical laws as measured; does not alter or reinterpret the physics itself.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the physical properties are removed or shown incorrect, the entire analogy collapses because the spiritual readings depend on those specific measured properties.
dg5_translation_registers: Physics register: measured properties of forces and laws.
Spiritual register: theological concepts (grace, love, truth, etc.).
Narrative register: the story of creation, fall, redemption.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Preserve as a narrative anchor with explicit kill conditions; do not treat as established physics or theology.

overstatement_risks: The spiritual readings may be seen as proven by the physics, but they are only analogies.
The claim that the pattern is 'checkable' may overstate the testability of the spiritual mapping.
The document's tone may lead readers to infer a stronger claim than the stated 'thought experiment'.
kill_conditions: If SPARC shows no G_eff modification needed.
If a closed-system model makes identical predictions.
If any of the ten physical properties are found to be incorrect.
risk.lean_target: A testable analogy with explicit falsification criteria, not a proof of God's existence or nature.

plain_summary: This document presents a thought experiment mapping ten physical laws to ten spiritual concepts, arguing that the pattern is checkable and has explicit kill conditions. It is not a formal proof but a narrative anchor with testable predictions.
